impact.text: previously valid orders could suddenly fall outside the new range

precondition_sources.text: The divergence cap is reduced via setDivergenceCap to a value lower than current orders' prices, so previously valid orders fall outside the new range.

intent_sources.text: Orders falling outside the price ranges on both standard and backstop orderbooks should be forcefully closed so they do not remain outside the divergence range.
